title: Has anyone tried astral projecting/lucid dreaming in the mall world?
content: Have you ever been able to lucidly explore the mall world, or are you always in the dream state? I’ve become lucid for a few minutes and then I either forget, or the dream people scare me and i wake up lol. I’m trying to practice lucid dreaming/astral projection, whatever you want to call it, and explore more.
